judge_input.description:
## Problem

`@effect/opentelemetry` is one that goes ahead and marks both `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-node` and `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-web` as being optional peer dependencies. However, the situation is that both of them are exported out of the main `index.ts`, and what that ends up doing is creating static ESM imports. The result of all of that is that module resolution errors get caused in those cases where users do not happen to have these packages installed at all:

```
Error: Cannot find package '@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-web' imported from 
.../@effect/opentelemetry/dist/esm/WebSdk.js
```

## Solution

Go ahead and make both `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-node` and `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-web` into required peer dependencies instead, and the way that this gets done is by removing the two of them from `peerDependenciesMeta`.

## Changes

- Removed the `optional: true` setting for `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-node`
- Removed the `optional: true` setting for `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-web`

## Testing

- The build passes without trouble
- Every single one of the tests passes as well (15/15)
